source_description_html:
Designed for maximum performance, this extra-large Screamin' Eagle Heavy Breather Extreme Air Filter flows 42% more air than a traditional Heavy Breather filter.
• Chrome finish
• Air moves smoothly through the filter due to an interior bell-shape feature and then travels through a unique round to an oval transitioned tube to improve leg clearance while providing unobstructed air to the throttle body
• At speeds over 60 mph, the filter captures air from the front, forcing the air through a smaller area to create a RAM air effect, while the long intake tube enhances torque beyond other Ventilator and Round High-Flow Filters for enhanced acceleration
• Designed to feed a large displacement engine enough clean air that can support output of over 150hp
• Water-resistant filter is washable and rechargeable
• Intake tube and back plate are dressed in mirror-like chrome and are made from cast aluminum
• All models require ECM calibration with Screamin' Eagle Pro Street Tuner for proper installation

The look is bold and the performance exhilarating. This race-inspired air cleaner is engineered to flow through the perimeter and the face of the air filter, providing high volumes of unrestricted airflow to the engine. The open-design face plate features a rich black finish with machined longitudinal strakes to expose the glowing aluminum below.

  • Gloss black finish

  • Includes air cleaner trim, one-piece cast back plate, high-flow washable air filter element, rain sock and all required hardware

  • All EFI-equipped models require ECM calibration (priced separately)

  • Recalibration is required for proper installation

  • Labor cost not included
